literal_meaning: পেটে আঘাত করা (to strike in the stomach)
figurative_meaning_en: To block the path of earning or livelihood
similar_in_english: To cut off someone's source of income
To pull the rug out from under someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীর ব্যবসা নষ্ট করে পেটে মারল।
দুর্ভিক্ষের কারণে গ্রামবাসীদের পেটে মারা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He sabotaged his rival's business, hitting him in the stomach.
The famine hit the villagers in the stomach by destroying their livelihoods.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to causing severe economic distress, evoking imagery of hunger and basic survival struggles common in Bengali folk expressions.
